name: Campaign Editor
description: Campaigns (.w3n projects) like the World Editor's Campaign Editor: name, author, description and difficulty, the campaign screen (background, ambient sound, fog, interface race) and the chapter buttons with their maps. Chapter maps are projects of their own under maps/; add maps and open them from here.

mcpTools.name: set_campaign_info
mcpTools.description: Changes a campaign project's General texts (name, difficulty, author, description), its interface race, and its chapter buttons' texts and whether the campaign screen shows them from the start, as one edit: the open Campaign Editor shows it at once. A text kept in the campaign's string table (war3campaign.wts) is changed there. Only what is given changes. Maps are added and removed in the Campaign Editor. Needs the setting mcp.writeTools; undo_last_edit takes it back.

difficulty.description: The difficulty text the campaign screen shows, like Normal.

chapters.description: Chapter buttons to change, by number.

number.description: The button, from 1, as campaign_info numbers them.

chapter.description: The button's first line, like Chapter One.

shown.description: Whether the campaign screen lists it from the start (others appear when a map unlocks them).

mcpTools.name: campaign_info
mcpTools.description: A campaign project's info (war3campaign.w3f): name, difficulty, author, description, interface race, the chapter buttons (number, texts, map, shown from the start) and its maps in order. Texts are read through the campaign's string table.
